Add Sturmjäger to your wishlist today! https://store.playstation.com/concept/10014504/

Coming to PlayStation®5 on January 14th, 2027!

Sturmjäger (シュトゥルムイェーガー) is a science-fiction shoot 'em up designed for players who want to jump straight into simple, fun, and over-the-top arcade action.

It features a two-player local co-op mode designed around shared fun rather than punishing failure. If a player loses all lives, that player isn't locked out with an early "Game Over". Instead, as long as the remaining player survives solo for roughly 30 seconds, the downed player automatically respawns back into the action.

The rules are simple: If it moves, shoot it. If it doesn't move... maybe shoot it anyway!

Chaotic bomb disposal fun with friends & monkeys! Work together as a 3-player co-op team of blind, deaf and mute monkeys. Each player has only part of the needed information. Communicate, solve puzzles, and race against the clock. Can you defuse the bombs before they explode?

- 3-Player Co-op: No more, no less. Exactly three monkeys required.

- 3 Game Modes:
  - Campaign: 30 handcrafted levels with increasing difficulty.
  - Endless: Procedurally generated, wave-based levels that keep getting harder.
  - Custom: Players create their own challenge by adjusting bomb difficulty, the timer, module
types, environmental hazards, and how many mistakes are allowed.

- Asymmetric Roles: Every player sees, hears, and acts differently.

- Fun interactions: Point, wave, gesture or flail wildly. Your options are only limited by your imagination and each player's Emote wheel.

- Slapping: Obviously an essential feature.
